title: "Stick Shift" segment - product review of Vater's Fatback 3A drumsticks.
description: Welcome to an episode of "Stick Shift" from yours truly here at Speaking In Drums.  This segment is my post-show talk about the drumsticks I used from this past Saturday's night show where I took the Vater Fatback 3A's for a spin.  I give a run-down on the specs and performance of the stick and how it appeals to my playing.  Some other stories including finally getting them literally in my hands are included as well.
